combo.description: Use E to engage then before it ends, R your target to stun them. Then instantly tap Q and AA
E W towards your target, then instantly then tap Q and mid animation Flash to extend the range of both Q and the stun. Quickly R once your E lands.

Stun multiple people in fights by using E through your first two targets then R behind your fourth target. While in the air Flash to cause your E stun to hit a third target right as your E moves through your second target.
For longer range engages hold Q then quickly Flash and let go of your Q. Follow up with an instant E, then R once they are stunned.
E then quickly hit your R max distance before the stun reaches you. Follow it up with an instant Flash to the other side of your opponent to land the stun.
E towards your target, then right before the stun reaches you Flash behind them to make the stun connect. Instantly tap Q followed by an R once they are in execute range.
For a normal all in hold Q then E away as soon as you let go, R after the stun lands and W away.
Hold Q then after you let go instantly R the location your target will be dragged to, then E W to escape.
Use E and W for a burst of speed to land the stun. Get behind your target then AA, tap Q, followed by AA's until they are in execute range then R.
If you cannot hook tap Q to slow then instantly AA E and continue to AA.
Your most basic combo will hold Q, then as soon as you let go instantly E toward your target and AA.
When hunting an enemy W to get closer then E through your target. Quickly tap Q when you land followed by some AA's.
